1. (Currently amended) A composition, comprising: cavity-generating particles having a size of 100-200 micrometers; a thermally conductive binder comprising a thermally conductive epoxy; and a solvent.

2. (Currently amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein the composition is applied to an electronic component surface and forms boiling nucleation sites on the surface.

3. (Previously presented) The composition of claim 2, wherein the solvent is removed during application to the electronic component surface.
